MANILA, Philippines – Malacañang suspended face-to-face classes in all levels for public and private schools in Metro Manila on August 23, 2026 due to heavy rainfall.
Manila City suspended face-to-face classes in all levels for public and private schools on August 23, 2026 due to flooding.
